paperTitle: Emotional Tissue: A Novel Widget for Character Emotion Visualization in Empathy Games
centralContribution: This work introduces Emotional Tissue, a novel widget designed to visually represent characters' emotional states in digital games, particularly empathy games. It models emotions as an organic, shaded cloth deformation whose pulse frequency directly correlates with emotion intensity and whose colors represent specific feelings defined by the game designer, providing an intuitive and objective emotional display unlike conventional UI elements.

units.title: Abstract
units.summary: Addressing challenges in visualizing character emotions for empathy games.

content.description: The representation of emotional states in graphical user interfaces is often neglected due to the complexity of capture and visualization, yet it is critical in empathy games where players must recognize character emotions to make effective gameplay decisions. Traditional UI widgets like level bars are too mechanical to convey emotions. Prior works, while addressing user emotion visualization, often have predefined color schemes, a mechanical appearance, and are not specifically tailored for character emotions as gameplay elements within digital games, necessitating a more organic, flexible, and game-centric approach.
